d: Hong Kong—a region renowned for having the highest number of skyscrapers in the world, home to Asia's oldest funicular railway, and the site where the 'Big Buddha' statue sits majestically amidst the hills. It is a place that holds the legacy of martial arts legends like Bruce Lee and Jackie Chan. There is so much more to Hong Kong that you simply must know. So, come along with us on a journey to Hong Kong—right here on Infinity Stream.
